purpose.zh: 腿往旁边滑到最远时练大腿内侧，帮你练横叉
purpose.en: Builds your inner thigh as your leg slides far out to the side, helping your side splits.

text.zh: 腿伸直往旁边滑出去，再用大腿内侧拉回来
text.en: Slide your straight leg out to the side, then pull it back with your inner thigh

text.zh: 一只脚踩滑垫，另一边膝盖弯、屁股往后坐。
text.en: One foot on the slider, bend the other knee and sit your hips back.

text.zh: 滑到还能拉回来的距离就停，别硬撑。
text.en: Stop where you can still pull back. Don't force it.

commonErrors.en: Sliding so far you can't pull back.

commonErrors.zh: 滑出去时站着那条腿的膝盖往里扣
commonErrors.en: Standing knee caving in as the other leg slides out.

cautions.zh: 大腿内侧或膝盖疼就滑近点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your inner thigh or knee hurts, don't slide as far. Stop if it still hurts.
